title: A machine lost mid-film costs at most a moment of buffering
description: Serves PRODUCT.md: "Failures are invisible. A machine that dies mid-film costs at most a moment of buffering, never the stream, the place in the film or the subtitles." and goal 2. The engine's failover is carried over in stage 1 but not proven with the new server's playback on Octave's players.
acceptanceCriteria: Losing any one machine running any role mid-film costs a viewer at most a moment of buffering, never the stream, the place or the subtitles, shown on Media3 and in a browser.
A worker removed on purpose while films play costs no viewer a stall.
The operator sees what was lost, when, and what took over.
notes: Coarse: sharpened when stage 2 is planned in detail.
